output.summary: Perennial flowering plant native to Eurasia. Its delicately scented flowers appear singly in early spring and are typically pale yellow, although wild white and pink forms occur. The flowers open flat, while the leaves often form a heavily wrinkled, evergreen rosette in favourable habitats.
output.edibilityNote: Flowers and leaves are edible; leaves may be cooked in soup or used for tea, while young flowers can make wine.
